newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Bridge to explore alternatives.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Bridge to explore alternatives.

text.p: Dominion Bridge Corp said Wednesday the board unanimously approved a proposal to explore strategic alternatives designed to enhance stockholder value.
Dominion said alternatives could include forming strategic alliances or joint ventures, or the possible merger or business combination of the company or any of its subsidiaries with another entity.

The company said no assurance can be given that any deals will occur as a result of this initiative. The company said it has not been approached by anyone nor has it initiated any formal discussions in respect of this initiative.
Dominion has retained Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc as financial advisor in connection with this process.
